question: Estimate the reach of a WhatsApp Business broadcast to 5 lakh customers.
idealClarificationQuestions: Reach = messages successfully delivered AND read? Yes.
Sender = brand using WhatsApp Business API (e.g., Tata Cliq, Lenskart)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Delivery rate (active WhatsApp accounts, not blocked): ~92-95% = 4.65 lakh delivered.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: CTR on a CTA in the message (link click): ~10-15% of opened = ~50K clicks.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Delivery rate (active WhatsApp accounts, not blocked)
CTR on a CTA in the message (link click)

calculationFlow: Delivery rate (active WhatsApp accounts, not blocked): ~92-95% = 4.65 lakh delivered.
Open rate (read in first 24 hours — WhatsApp dramatically outperforms email): ~75-85% = ~3.7 lakh read.
CTR on a CTA in the message (link click): ~10-15% of opened = ~50K clicks.
